description: This file defines classes related to managing and representing test runs, including filtering, sharding, and serialization of test configurations for pytest.

classes.name: TestRun
classes.description: Represents a set of tests to be run, with support for inclusion/exclusion filters, containment checks, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: ShardedTest
classes.description: Represents a sharded subset of a test, including timing information and methods for comparison and pytest argument generation.

methods.name: TestRun.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a TestRun with a filename, optional included and excluded test sets.

methods.name: TestRun.is_empty
methods.description: Checks if the TestRun is empty (no test file specified).

methods.name: TestRun.is_full_file
methods.description: Checks if the TestRun includes the entire test file.

methods.name: TestRun.included
methods.description: Returns the set of included tests.

methods.name: TestRun.excluded
methods.description: Returns the set of excluded tests.

methods.name: TestRun.get_pytest_filter
methods.description: Generates a pytest filter string based on included or excluded tests.

methods.name: TestRun.contains
methods.description: Checks if this TestRun contains another TestRun.

methods.name: TestRun.__copy__
methods.description: Creates a copy of the TestRun.

methods.name: TestRun.__bool__
methods.description: Returns True if the TestRun is not empty.

methods.name: TestRun.__repr__
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the TestRun.

methods.name: TestRun.__str__
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly string of the TestRun.

methods.name: TestRun.__eq__
methods.description: Checks equality between two TestRun instances.

methods.name: TestRun.__hash__
methods.description: Returns a hash of the TestRun.

methods.name: TestRun.__or__
methods.description: Returns the union of two TestRuns.

methods.name: TestRun.__sub__
methods.description: Returns the difference of two TestRuns.

methods.name: TestRun.__and__
methods.description: Returns the intersection of two TestRuns.

methods.name: TestRun.to_json
methods.description: Serializes the TestRun to a JSON-compatible dictionary.

methods.name: TestRun.from_json
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON dictionary into a TestRun.

methods.name: ShardedTest.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a ShardedTest with a TestRun, shard index, total shards, and optional timing.

methods.name: ShardedTest.name
methods.description: Returns the test file name.

methods.name: ShardedTest.__eq__
methods.description: Checks equality between two ShardedTest instances.

methods.name: ShardedTest.__repr__
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ShardedTest.

methods.name: ShardedTest.__lt__
methods.description: Defines less-than comparison for sorting ShardedTests.

methods.name: ShardedTest.__str__
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ShardedTest.

methods.name: ShardedTest.get_time
methods.description: Returns the timing of the test, or a default if None.

methods.name: ShardedTest.get_pytest_args
methods.description: Returns pytest command-line arguments for the test filter.
